_meta.purpose: Keyless public board archives. Titles and ranks only. Each source is a candidate; login wall, captcha, empty, or 暂无数据 is a silent board, never a zero.
_meta.safety: No user pages, no login, no profiles, no Douyin signed APIs, no RapidAPI, no Xiaohongshu, no invented Telegram handles.

disclosure: Every board is itself a curated or censored surface. This dump is permitted attention, not uncensored public opinion.
